execution_grant_freeze.allocation_reuse_requirement: The preflight allocation is never released and reacquired between receipt and execution. A later allocation cannot activate this grant.
execution_grant_freeze.binding: The exact-one execution grant binds every identity from the one live held allocation. Execution may proceed only inside that same allocation after worker-side upstream grant activation and exact-pin verification.
execution_grant_freeze.timing: once, after the separately authorized Slurm allocation/preflight and before any IC, field, PM, or member generation

execution_rules.syn101_semantics: No manual/direct execution is permitted. It may be used only if selected by an authorized Slurm allocation and exactly pinned by the later execution grant.

held_allocation_failure_semantics.future_recovery: A new allocation requires separate explicit authorization and a new versioned execution grant with a new direct-child lineage. The old grant is immutable, is never altered or reused, and cannot authorize the new allocation.

pregrant_allocation_preflight.controller_during_hold: From syntax, the driver uses the hardware/runtime receipt to create, audit, commit, and push the separately authorized execution grant while the allocation stays live.
grant_activation_gate_order: controller creates and audits exact-one grant
controller commits and pushes grant under separate authorization
worker fetches upstream grant inside the same still-live allocation
worker verifies runtime HEAD, lineage, implementation hashes, node/GPU UUIDs, driver/CUDA, Python/packages, variables, and resources exactly
only an exact verification pass opens the IC/field/PM/scoring gate
must_identify: repository implementation commit and exact file SHA256/modes
pregrant_allocation_preflight.post_receipt_state: The same allocation remains active and blocked at a worker-side grant gate. No IC, field, PM, scoring, or scientific output may begin.
pregrant_allocation_preflight.purpose: Obtain a non-scientific Slurm allocation on a concrete compute node and inspect runtime identity before the execution grant.
pregrant_allocation_preflight.worker_during_hold: The allocated worker may inspect and wait only. It must not cross the science gate until it fetches/verifies upstream, proves runtime HEAD is the committed grant, validates the exact grant lineage and every hardware/runtime pin, and records an exact pass.
